2609.11900.title: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
2609.11900.paper_summary: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo evaluates each property at two cognitive levels. Reasoning asks a model to identify topological relations or infer how they change. Planning instantiates a foundation model as a closed-loop agent whose policy selects environment actions. MindTopo contains 11,030 instances across 13 procedurally generated task types with controllable difficulty. We benchmark 14 MLLMs and study agent configurations augmented with image and video generation, including 3 video generative models in planning settings. Every MLLM performs better on reasoning than on planning, and the best-performing model remains far below observed human performance. On Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning improve reasoning more than planning. Generated observations retain local cues and reach plausible endpoints, but audited rollouts do not reliably follow environment dynamics or preserve topology across transitions. Our website is at https://mind-topo.github.io/
2609.11900.paper_summary_zh: 空間推理不僅依賴於距離、角度和形狀等度量性質，還依賴於在連續變形下保持不變的拓撲關係。認知科學將這些關係視為空間理解的基礎，然而基礎模型的評估主要集中在度量或視角依賴的關係上。我們介紹了 MindTopo，一個基於認知科學和形式拓撲的五個性質的拓撲直覺基準：連續性、分離性、順序性、包圍性和結。MindTopo 在兩個認知層面上評估每個性質。推理要求模型識別拓撲關係或推斷它們如何變化。規劃將基礎模型實例化為一個閉環代理，其策略選擇環境行動。MindTopo 包含 11,030 個實例，涵蓋 13 種程序生成的任務類型，並具有可控的難度。我們對 14 個 MLLM 進行基準測試，並研究增強圖像和視頻生成的代理配置，包括在規劃設置中使用的 3 個視頻生成模型。每個 MLLM 在推理上的表現優於規劃，且表現最佳的模型仍遠低於觀察到的人類表現。在 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 上，監督微調和強化學習對推理的改善超過了對規劃的改善。生成的觀察保留了局部線索並達到合理的端點，但審計的展開並不可靠地遵循環境動態或在過渡中保持拓撲。我們的網站位於 https://mind-topo.github.io/
